title: crataegus crus-galli f. rubens
intro: Crataegus crus-galli f. rubens, commonly known as the red-barked hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote cardiovascular health, and its potential health benefits include reducing blood pressure, improving lipid profiles, and exerting antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus crus-galli f. rubens include vasodilation, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as atherosclerosis and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids (e.g., quercetin, epicatechin), phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
